name: Dominate Monster

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

upcast.text: With a level 9 slot, Concentration can last up to 8 hours.

summary: Wis save or a creature is Charmed and follows your telepathic orders; it repeats the save whenever it takes damage.
text: The target saves with Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it. You command it on your turn with no action needed, and it acts on its own to stay safe once an order is done; ordering it to use its Reaction costs your Reaction. With a level 9 slot, Concentration can last up to 8 hours.
